text:
maria: Heads up - on the canary I noticed a bunch of requests showing up as "unattributed" in the console sampling view. Quota anchors look wrong for SA keys.
alex: Is sampling dropping origin header or is the attribution join failing?
samir: Pulled a raw trace - request had X-Origin: project/none and key id in headers, aggregation matched to org because project was empty. Seems like sampling + join order edgecase.
maria: Exactly. Sampling before enrichment causes the sample set to miss project claims, dashboards undercount project usage and that screws canary rollouts for dedicated customers.
jeff: Can you paste the minimal repro/query?
samir: Sure, simplified repro from telemetry pipeline:
```sql
-- sampling applied early
WITH sampled AS (
  SELECT * FROM requests WHERE bernoulli(0.005) -- early sample
)
SELECT sampled.id, requests.headers->>'key_id' as key_id, enrich_project(requests.headers) as project
FROM sampled JOIN requests ON sampled.id = requests.id;
```
jeff: Yup sampling before enrichment is the bug. Options: deterministic sampling on key_id or delay sampling until after enrichment.
maria: I prefer deterministic sampling keyed on key_id so small projects are preserved for attribution. Less ET cost and stable across retries.
alex: Tradeoff: deterministic keyed sampling biases toward heavy keys. Maybe do two-tier: deterministic hash(key_id) for attribution samples + independent uniform sample for perf metrics.
samir: Hashing token string in streaming code is cheap. We currently use request-level jittered random.
ops-bot: reminder - canary window 16:00-18:00 UTC, auto-rollback on error rate > 1.5%. :warning:
maria: Proposal: compute sample_bucket = fnv1a(key_id) % 10000 and keep rows where sample_bucket < 50 (0.5%) for attribution flows. Keep existing 0.5% random sample for perf.
jeff: Migration: backfill 7 days is heavy. Suggest forward-only with dashboard annotation "post-deterministic-sampling" and UI flag to include pre-migration data.
alex: Forward-only + UI toggle for historical comparison is fine. Ops can delay SLO gating 48h.
maria: I'll open a PR with code change + dashboard flag and add a unit test to ensure project enrichment always precedes quota attribution.
samir: Test idea: fuzz headers with missing project claim and assert deterministic hash yields identical sample decision on retries.
jeff: Thanks. If anything noisy in prod, ping #eng-oncall and tag me.
maria: Posting PR shortly. :thumbsup:
